sip-request.regex:
^(INVITE|REGISTER|ACK|BYE|OPTIONS) sip:[a-z0-9._-]+@[a-z0-9.-]+ SIP/2\.0
Via: SIP/2\.0/TCP [a-z0-9.-]+;branch=z9hG4bK[a-zA-Z0-9]+
From: <sip:[a-z0-9._-]+@[a-z0-9.-]+>;tag=[a-zA-Z0-9]+
To: <sip:[a-z0-9._-]+@[a-z0-9.-]+>
Call-ID: [a-zA-Z0-9]+@[a-z0-9.-]+
CSeq: [0-9]+ (INVITE|REGISTER|ACK|BYE|OPTIONS)
Content-Length: 0

$
sip-request.description: SIP/2.0 request line (INVITE/REGISTER/ACK/BYE/OPTIONS) with the mandatory Via/From/To/Call-ID/CSeq headers

sip-response.regex:
^SIP/2\.0 (100 Trying|180 Ringing|200 OK|404 Not Found)
Via: SIP/2\.0/TCP [a-z0-9.-]+;branch=z9hG4bK[a-zA-Z0-9]+
From: <sip:[a-z0-9._-]+@[a-z0-9.-]+>;tag=[a-zA-Z0-9]+
To: <sip:[a-z0-9._-]+@[a-z0-9.-]+>
Call-ID: [a-zA-Z0-9]+@[a-z0-9.-]+
CSeq: [0-9]+ (INVITE|REGISTER|ACK|BYE|OPTIONS)
Content-Length: 0

$
sip-response.description: SIP/2.0 status line (100/180/200/404) with the mandatory Via/From/To/Call-ID/CSeq headers
